description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages NFC provisioning UI, including fragment transactions, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that initializes NFC provisioning fragment, manages menu options, and sets up logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds NFC provisioning fragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, toggling log visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log wrapper, filter, and log fragment.
